meta.name: x-arp
meta.description:
Display ARP cache table with MAC vendor lookup and suspicious 
entry detection. Supports CSV, TSV, and TUI output.

**Dependency**: This is an x-cmd module. Install x-cmd first (see x-cmd skill for installation options).
see x-cmd skill for installation.

copy.tagline: 查看ARP缓存并检测可疑条目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要检查局域网设备并发现异常MAC地址
copy.tagline_en: Display ARP cache and detect suspicious entries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to inspect LAN devices and spot unusual MAC addresses

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以显示本机的 ARP 缓存表，并自动查询 MAC 地址对应的厂商，标记可疑条目。支持表格、CSV 等格式输出。
howto.when: 当用户要求查看网络设备列表、检查 ARP 缓存或排查网络问题时触发。

say.text: 显示我的 ARP 缓存表
say.note: 以交互式表格展示所有 ARP 条目。

say.text: 用 CSV 格式导出 ARP 表
say.note: 输出 CSV 格式，便于导入电子表格。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can display the local ARP cache table, automatically look up MAC vendor, and flag suspicious entries. Supports table, CSV, and other output formats.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to view network device list, check ARP cache, or troubleshoot network issues.

say_en.note: Displays all ARP entries in an interactive table.

say_en.text: Export ARP table in CSV format
say_en.note: Outputs CSV format for easy import into spreadsheets.
